name: accordion
description: Grouped disclosures. Items are fixed for the mount. Expansion is handed to the caller when `value` is set.

props.name: type
props.description: `single` keeps one section open; `multiple` lets several stay open.

name: action-rail
description: An action row with wrapping groups. The rail owns order, start/end anchoring, the gap between groups and the rule that the submit action stays visible; callers pass actions.

props.name: leading
props.description: Actions anchored to the start of the row.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Selection or secondary actions that stay together before the submit action.

props.name: submit
props.description: The final action; flexible leading and trailing actions wrap to keep it visible.

name: action-row
description: A row of actions that stays on one line while it fits and stacks whole when it does not: text actions become full-width lines in DOM order and icon actions stay together, so a row never ends ragged or leaves one action alone. Keep the primary action last.

name: alert
description: A message about the page or a task, in one of the status tones. Urgency is explicit, independent of the visual tone.

name: app-bar
description: Compact application chrome: one title, one optional status line, and the actions that belong to the whole screen. The page body keeps its own scroll.

props.name: status
props.description: A short status line under the title, typically ChatStatus.

name: aspect-ratio
description: Keeps its content at a fixed width-to-height ratio. The ratio is layout, not a theme surface. Children choose their own media fitting.

name: assistant-markdown
description: The Assistant's text: the shared Markdown blocks under the Assistant's own part.

name: assistant-view
description: A complete default Assistant surface. Data, permissions, network and business lifetime stay with the host.

props.name: readState
props.description: First loading, empty, and refresh failure with retained messages are separate states.

props.name: draft
props.description: Supplying draft makes the host its sole owner, even for a plain value.

props.name: onSubmit
props.type: (draft: AssistantDraft) => { accepted: boolean } | Promise<{ accepted: boolean }>
props.description: Only an explicit accepted:true may clear an unchanged submitted snapshot.

props.name: onAttach
props.type: ( files: readonly File[], ) => readonly AssistantAttachment[] | void | Promise<readonly AssistantAttachment[] | void>
props.description: Host attachment ingestion. Return normalized entries or update controlled draft. No upload is implicit.

props.name: allowAttachments
props.description: Disable local file selection when the host supports only already-normalized attachments.

props.name: onToolAction
props.description: An explicit host intent. The host owns availability, execution and subsequent state.

props.name: onMessageAction
props.description: Feedback and regeneration intents on a finished reply; supplying it shows those actions. Copy is built in.

props.name: history
props.description: The column of the reader's own messages over the transcript; on by default.

props.name: renderPart
props.description: Return undefined to keep the default renderer for this one part.

props.name: composerTriggers
props.description: Characters that open host suggestions in the composer (`@` mentions, `/` commands). Fixed for the mount. Accepted suggestions become draft text; structured references stay with the host.

name: autocomplete
description: A text field that offers host suggestions without constraining the text. Focus stays in the input; the list is a popup listbox driven by the arrow keys.

props.name: id
props.description: Id of the text input; also the base for the list ids. Generated when omitted.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled text. Omit it to keep a local draft that starts at defaultValue.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called for every edit and for an accepted suggestion.

props.name: suggestions
props.description: Host-filtered suggestions for the current text; the component never filters or fetches.

props.name: onAccept
props.description: Called after an accepted suggestion's value is written to the text.

props.name: loading
props.description: The host is looking up suggestions. Pass it (also as false) to enable the empty message.

props.name: listLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the suggestion list.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Shown when `loading` is given and false, the text is not empty and there are no suggestions.

name: avatar
description: A face or the initials that remain when the image is missing.

props.name: name
props.description: Used for initials and the accessible name.

name: badge
description: A non-interactive indicator for a status or count.

name: breadcrumb
description: The trail of pages from the top of a site to the current one.

name: button
description: Triggers one action, in one of six levels and three sizes.

props.name: href
props.description: Use a native link for navigation while keeping the shared action appearance.

name: card
description: A bordered surface that groups one object's title, content and actions.

name: card-action
description: The actions at the end of a card header.

name: card-content
description: The body of a card.

name: card-description
description: The supporting line under a card title.

name: card-footer
description: The row of actions at the end of a card; it stacks whole when it does not fit, like ActionRow.

name: card-header
description: The top of a card: its title, description and actions.

name: card-title
description: The title of a card.

props.name: as
props.description: Defaults to one level below the surrounding `Page` or `Section` heading (h2 at the top).

name: chart
description: A bar or line chart of host data. Color is never the only cue: a legend names every series, line markers differ by shape, and a data table carries every value.

props.name: type
props.description: Bars compare categories; a line follows a trend. Fixed for the mount.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the figure; shown as its caption.

props.name: series
props.description: At most eight series, in the fixed color order; later ones are not drawn.

props.name: unit
props.description: Appended to every value, for example "%" or " ms".

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Formats ticks, the inspection readout and the table. Overrides `unit`.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in px. The width follows the container.

props.name: categoryLabel
props.description: Header of the table's first column.

props.name: hint
props.description: How to read values with the keyboard, read when the plot takes focus.
props.default: "Use the left and right arrow keys to read each category."

name: chat-attachments
description: Files attached to a message or a draft, with preview, download and remove actions.

props.name: items
props.description: Plain arrays are fixed for the mount. A signal updates rows in place.

name: chat-bubble
description: A message surface; placement and author metadata belong to ChatMessage.

name: chat-composer
description: The message input of a conversation, with attachments, choices, suggestions and send.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled text; a Signal stays live. Omit it to keep a local draft that starts at defaultValue.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called for every edit and for text the composer writes itself (an accepted suggestion, a reset).

props.name: attachments
props.description: Draft attachments belong to the same writing surface; upload ownership stays with the host.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Choices the draft is submitted with (model, project, priority) beside the send action, usually host-controlled ChoiceSelects; options and state belong to the host.

props.name: hint
props.description: Supporting instructions below the writing surface, associated through hintId.

props.name: submitContent
props.description: Visible action content; the accessible name always comes from submitLabel.

props.name: submitDisabled
props.description: Prevent another submission while keeping the draft editable.

props.name: submitOn
props.description: Which key submits: "none" (Enter inserts a newline), "enter" (Shift+Enter for a newline) or "mod-enter" (Cmd+Enter or Ctrl+Enter). A blocked composer swallows the key; IME composition never submits. Fixed for the mount.

props.name: triggers
props.description: Characters that open host suggestions while writing. Fixed for the mount; use `disabled` on one.

props.name: suggestionPlacement
props.description: Where the suggestion list opens relative to the writing surface; it flips when there is no room.

props.name: loadingMessage
props.description: Status shown while a trigger's lookup is pending.

name: chat-conversation
description: A scrolling transcript that follows new messages. Optional scroll owner for append-only transcripts. Give the root a constrained height. Do not combine with an application-owned scroll controller. Children can use ChatMessageList.

name: chat-frame
description: The outer surface of a conversation that holds its header, messages and composer.

name: chat-header
description: The top of a conversation: its title, status and actions.

name: chat-message
description: One message in a conversation: the author, the time, the body and its actions.

props.name: surface
props.description: Omit the automatic surface when composing multiple bubbles, files or process blocks.

props.name: continuation
props.description: Joins a reply, retaining its author and the column of a supplied avatar.

name: chat-message-actions
description: The row of actions under a message, such as copy or retry.

name: chat-message-list
description: The ordered messages of a conversation, announced as a log.

name: chat-process
description: A collapsible row for work that happened between messages, with its details inside.

name: chat-question
description: A question the assistant asks the user, with choices and a written answer. Presentation only: submission, cancellation and question lifetime belong to the host.

name: chat-reasoning
description: A model's visible reasoning before it answers. While active it stays open and shows the newest lines under a fading edge; when the host marks it inactive it folds to one disclosure row like ChatProcess. Unrelated to the composer's reasoning-effort picker (`reasoningOptions`), which chooses how much to reason.

props.name: label
props.description: What the model is doing now, for example "Drafting the rollout policy".

props.name: doneLabel
props.description: The summary once the work stops, for example "Thought for 12s"; the host measures it.

props.name: text
props.description: The reasoning text the host streams in; shown as plain text, never as markup.

name: chat-sources
description: The sources an answer cites, as a collapsible list of links.

name: chat-status
description: The connection or activity state of a conversation, as a dot and a word.

name: chat-task
description: A task record, not an executable task or a whole-card control.

props.name: statusLabel
props.description: Explain the current state, including who or what a waiting task needs.

props.name: executionText
props.description: Execution and a public reply are separate host facts. Neither infers the other.

props.name: progress
props.description: Explicit host progress only. Missing progress does not imply zero progress.

props.name: footer
props.description: Compose ordinary buttons and resource links outside the task's content.

name: chat-tool-call
description: One tool call in an assistant's work: what ran, on what, and how it ended.

props.name: summary
props.description: Short target or action summary, visible while collapsed.

props.name: statusLabel
props.description: The host's account of the state (who or what is being waited on, why it failed).

props.name: input
props.description: Tool payloads are inert text. Undefined omits a region; an empty string is explicit empty data.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Reveals this row's own body in place.

props.name: onActivate
props.description: Runs the host's own action instead of revealing a body; the row keeps the row chrome.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Intent only. The host owns execution, pending state, permissions and the resulting status.

props.name: canRetry
props.description: Whether the host currently offers this intent; unlike disabled, false hides it.

name: checkbox
description: A native checkbox with its label, including the mixed state.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Native indeterminate property. Assistive technology reads `aria-checked="mixed"`.

props.name: labelHidden
props.description: Keep the accessible name while hiding the visible label, for compact tables.

name: choice-group
description: Visible single choices with native radio keyboard, validation and form semantics.

props.name: options
props.description: Options are fixed for the mount.

name: choice-select
description: Single-choice listbox. Form participation remains native; data fetching belongs to callers.

props.name: options
props.description: Plain arrays are fixed for the mount. A signal keeps the open list mounted.

props.name: disabled
props.description: A Signal stays live, so a choice can follow a pending submit.

name: code-block
description: A block of code with its language, an optional title, soft wrap and copy.

props.name: title
props.description: The code surface's name, such as a file name or an example title, at the start of the header. A plain value is fixed for the mount; a Signal keeps the name live. Omit it for the language-only header.

props.name: caption
props.description: A quiet supporting line for the name, such as a path or a short note. A plain value is fixed for the mount; a Signal keeps it live. Omit it to hide the caption.

props.name: actions
props.description: Host buttons or links that extend the built-in wrap and copy controls; they render before those controls and do not replace them. A plain value is fixed for the mount; a Signal keeps the actions live.

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Hosts may supply a clipboard implementation; the default uses the browser clipboard.

name: command-palette
description: Search the host's commands, run one, and give focus back to where the reader was.

props.name: open
props.description: Required; the host owns the state and registers the shortcut that opens it.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with false when the reader dismisses the palette or runs a command.

props.name: onRun
props.description: Called after the palette has closed and focus has returned to the opener.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the dialog.

props.name: resultsMessage
props.description: The polite count announced as the query changes.

name: composer-panel
description: A ChatComposer and optional page-level meta row. The composer keeps its single writing surface and external hint; this panel owns the surrounding composition.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled text; a Signal stays live. Omit it to keep a local draft that starts at defaultValue.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called for every edit and for text the composer writes itself (an accepted suggestion, a reset).

props.name: attachments
props.description: Draft attachments belong to the same writing surface; upload ownership stays with the host.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Choices the draft is submitted with (model, project, priority) beside the send action, usually host-controlled ChoiceSelects; options and state belong to the host.

props.name: hint
props.description: Supporting instructions below the writing surface, associated through hintId.

props.name: submitContent
props.description: Visible action content; the accessible name always comes from submitLabel.

props.name: submitDisabled
props.description: Prevent another submission while keeping the draft editable.

props.name: submitOn
props.description: Which key submits: "none" (Enter inserts a newline), "enter" (Shift+Enter for a newline) or "mod-enter" (Cmd+Enter or Ctrl+Enter). A blocked composer swallows the key; IME composition never submits. Fixed for the mount.

props.name: triggers
props.description: Characters that open host suggestions while writing. Fixed for the mount; use `disabled` on one.

props.name: suggestionPlacement
props.description: Where the suggestion list opens relative to the writing surface; it flips when there is no room.

props.name: loadingMessage
props.description: Status shown while a trigger's lookup is pending.

props.name: meta
props.description: Page-level facts below the writing surface, usually a MetaRow.

name: container
description: Centers content at one of the page widths.

name: context-menu
description: Right-click or Shift+F10 opens the existing Menu, including nested items.

props.name: id
props.description: Base id for the ARIA references this component wires; generated when omitted.

name: description-item
description: A native description group; its value can compose text and existing layout components.

name: description-list
description: Related terms and values share a natural label column within the available width.

name: detail-section
description: One titled block inside a detail surface (a side panel or a full-screen reader). Blocks are separated by a hairline; the heading is a small label, not a page title. Its level sits one below the surrounding `Page` or `Section` heading, and nested sections continue from it.

props.name: aside
props.description: A quiet fact on the heading line, such as a count or a caveat.

name: dialog
description: The native dialog element, themed; Modal builds a complete dialog on top of it. Its title is an h2 (`DialogHeader`), so sections and card titles inside it start at h3.

name: dialog-actions
description: The row of buttons that ends a dialog; it stacks whole when it does not fit, like ActionRow.

name: dialog-header
description: The title block of a dialog: an optional eyebrow, the title, a description and actions.

name: dialog-panel
description: The body of a dialog, with an optional header that stays in place while the body scrolls.

name: diff-block
description: A file diff: removed and added lines with their context. Hosts provide semantic diff rows; this view does not infer changes or apply patches.

name: disclosure
description: A section the reader can expand and collapse. Native details owns expansion and keyboard behavior, independently of the theme.

name: drawer
description: A modal panel that slides in from the start edge over a scrim, for navigation on narrow screens. The native dialog supplies focus containment and Escape; the scrim dismisses.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the drawer.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the reader dismisses the drawer (scrim, Escape); the owner updates `open`.

name: empty-state
description: What a region shows while it has nothing: artwork, a title, a line of help and an optional next step.

props.name: illustration
props.description: Artwork above the title. Omitted uses `EmptyStack`. `null` and `false` leave the illustration part out. Presence is fixed for the mount.

name: entry
description: One summary of a piece of content: an optional kicker, a titled heading that can link to the content, a standfirst and its facts. In an EntryList it is a list item; on its own it is an article. Its heading level follows the surrounding `Page` or `Section`.

props.name: title
props.description: The entry's name; rendered as a heading one level below the surrounding region.

props.name: href
props.description: Where the entry lives; the title links to it.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: A short kicker above the title, such as the date or the section.

props.name: description
props.description: One or two sentences that say what the entry is about.

props.name: meta
props.description: Facts under the description, such as a byline, reading time or tags.

name: entry-list
description: A run of content entries, such as posts, notes or releases. Entries are separated by hairlines and sit on the surrounding surface; there is no box around the run.

name: field
description: A labelled form control with optional help text and an error message.

props.name: htmlFor
props.description: Id of the labelled control. When omitted, Field uses the single child control's own `id`, or generates one and gives it to that control.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Explicit state takes precedence over the live error message.

name: field-group
description: A titled set of related fields, as a native fieldset.

name: form
description: A native form for a settings or connection task: validation stays native, values stay in the host's controls, and submission, busy state and results belong to the host.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called only after native constraint validation passes, with the form's data including the submitter. The browser's own submission is prevented; the native onSubmit is not forwarded.

props.name: busy
props.description: The host is saving: the form reports busy and a submit in the meantime is not reported.

props.name: error
props.description: A host failure for the whole form, shown above the actions as an alert.

props.name: status
props.description: A polite receipt, such as "Saved", shown above the actions.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Adds a Cancel action; the host decides what cancelling keeps.

props.name: actions
props.description: Replaces the Save and Cancel actions; place them in the order Cancel, then the primary.

name: grid
description: Lays out children in responsive columns.

name: hover-card
description: A preview card that opens while a trigger is hovered or focused; its text stays selectable. Popover owns positioning, Escape, outside dismissal and focus.

props.name: id
props.description: Base id for the ARIA references this component wires; generated when omitted.

name: icon-button
description: A button that shows only an icon and carries its name for assistive technology.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name; a Signal keeps it live (e.g. Copy → Copied).

name: icon-rail
description: A narrow icon column that expands into a labelled drawer over the page. The column keeps its width in the layout, so expanding never reflows the content beside it.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the navigation.

props.name: footer
props.description: Pinned to the bottom, for example settings.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Keep the drawer open; by default it expands over the page on hover or keyboard focus.

name: image-lightbox
description: A full-screen viewer for one image. Native modal top layer keeps the preview independent of transformed ancestors.

name: image-preview
description: Passive media display; navigation, preview activation and URL authorization belong to the host.

name: inline
description: Lays out children in a row that wraps, with a gap from the spacing scale.

name: input
description: A single-line text input.

name: item
description: A selectable or navigable list item. Button and link content must not contain nested controls.

props.name: href
props.description: Makes the whole item a link to this destination, overriding `as`. A selected link item is the current destination and carries `aria-current="page"`; routing stays with the host.

name: json-block
description: A collapsible block that shows a JSON value as a tree. Serialization and rendering wait for expansion. Invalid text remains verbatim.
extends: ({ text: string; payload?: never } | { payload: unknown; text?: never })

name: json-tree
description: A JSON value as an expandable tree. Children are materialized only when their branch is first expanded.

name: layout-item
description: A wrapper that sets how one child of a Stack or Inline grows, shrinks and aligns.

name: link
description: Themed inline text link. Whole-row references to an openable object stay with ResourceLink.

name: list-group
description: Rows that read as one set: a single rounded outline with hairlines between the rows.

name: list-row
description: A key/value or expandable detail row in a ListGroup, also usable alone as a summary.

props.name: tags
props.description: Tags beside the title, such as "CLI" or "Default".

props.name: status
props.description: A state in words with its dot; the row's only status.

props.name: tone
props.description: "accent" is the row the reader should notice first, such as the default.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Open content under the row, such as its editor. Children render here.

name: markdown
description: Agent or document text as safe Markdown: raw HTML and images stay text and only explicit external links navigate. Streaming text keeps finished blocks untouched.

props.name: text
props.description: Markdown source; a Signal keeps it live while it streams.

props.name: streaming
props.description: The text is still arriving: the open tail is completed so markers do not flash.

props.name: renderCode
props.description: Draws a fenced or indented code block, for example with CodeBlock. The Signal follows the block while it streams. Without it, code is a themed `pre`.

name: menu
description: A list of actions in a popover, with keyboard navigation and nested submenus.

props.name: id
props.description: Base id for the ARIA references this component wires; generated when omitted.

props.name: anchorRect
props.description: Position against a point such as a right-click, instead of the trigger box.

props.name: anchorElement
props.description: Element whose layout defines a custom rect; observed by the same autoUpdate.

name: mermaid-diagram
description: A Mermaid diagram drawn as themed SVG by Pele, with an optional title and a Copy source action. Before the client mounts it, and when the source cannot be drawn, it shows the source itself; links, images and icons inside diagrams are off, so untrusted text draws safely.

props.name: source
props.description: Mermaid source. A Signal re-renders the diagram in place.

props.name: title
props.description: The diagram's name at the start of the header. A plain value is fixed for the mount.

props.name: caption
props.description: A quiet supporting line for the name. A plain value is fixed for the mount.

props.name: actions
props.description: Host buttons or links; they render before the built-in Copy source action.

props.name: zoom
props.description: Zoom and pan controls: `"auto"` shows them only when the diagram is larger than its frame. Fixed for the mount.

props.name: limits
props.description: Tighter or looser bounds than the defaults (50,000 source characters, 2,000 edges).

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Hosts may supply a clipboard implementation; the default uses the browser clipboard.

name: meta-row
description: A page-level fact row. Items keep separators, wrap instead of clipping, and carry facts as text; the optional progress segment is one more fact.

props.name: items
props.description: Plain arrays are fixed for the mount. A signal keeps the row live.

props.name: progress
props.description: Finite values clamp to 0–100; non-finite values omit the progress segment. A signal stays live.

props.name: progressLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the progress segment.

name: modal
description: A complete native modal dialog over the `Dialog` primitives: the host owns the `open` state and every business action, while the Modal owns the native `showModal`/`close` mechanics, Escape and backdrop dismissal, focus return and the generated title/description ids.

props.name: open
props.description: Required; the host owns the state. A Signal keeps the dialog in sync after mount.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with `false` when the reader dismisses the dialog (Escape, backdrop, header close entry, or a native close). The owner decides whether `open` changes; a controlled host that ignores the call keeps the dialog open.

props.name: title
props.description: The dialog heading and accessible name.

props.name: description
props.description: Optional supporting line under the heading; it is wired to the dialog description.

props.name: actions
props.description: Optional bottom action row; omit it for a body-only dialog.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Default true; false removes the header close entry and Escape/backdrop dismissal.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the header close entry; default "Close".

props.name: id
props.description: Id of the transparent wrapper and base for the generated title/description ids. A generated base is used when omitted. Fixed for the mount.

name: nav-item
description: One navigation entry: an icon, a label and an optional badge, marked when it is the current location.

name: nav-list
description: Data-first site navigation: labelled groups of links and actions that own the grouping, the active location and the link/button semantics. The host owns routing, search filtering and what an item points at.

props.name: label
props.description: The navigation landmark name, rendered as the nav element's `aria-label`.

props.name: groups
props.description: The groups and items to render. Fixed for the mount: the list is built once and a later array change is ignored. The host owns filtering and rebuilding.

props.name: activeId
props.description: The active item id. Pass a Signal to keep `aria-current="page"` live.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with the item when an item without `href` is activated. Items with `href` navigate through their anchor; routing and search filtering stay with the host.

name: number-input
description: A number the user can type or step. Clamping and formatting happen on commit.

props.name: precision
props.description: Decimal places of a committed value. When omitted, derived from step.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Wrap prose-like tool output; code and terminal output keep their existing horizontal scroll.

name: page
description: A content page inside an existing host region: it arranges the identity block, an optional toolbar and notice, and the page content column. It creates no viewport and owns no scrolling; `PageFrame` stays the frame primitive for shells and dialogs. The identity block needs a `title` or a `header`; without either the page is only its toolbar, notice and content. Slots are fixed for the mount: presence decides whether a region renders, while a Signal passed as slot content still updates its text.

props.name: title
props.description: The page name; `PageHeader` renders it as the h1. Required unless `header` is given: with neither, the page renders no identity block and keeps only its toolbar, notice and content.

props.name: description
props.description: One line of purpose under the title. Ignored without a title or header.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Optional small label above the title. Ignored without a title or header.

props.name: actions
props.description: Page-level actions, placed in the header. Ignored without a title or header.

props.name: leading
props.description: A mark before the title, forwarded to `PageHeader`. Ignored without a title or when `header` replaces the identity block. Presence is fixed for the mount.

props.name: header
props.description: Escape hatch: replaces the eyebrow and the `PageHeader` identity block with host chrome, and needs no `title`. `title`, `description`, `eyebrow`, `leading` and `actions` are then unused.

props.name: toolbar
props.description: Optional bar below the header for filters or view controls.

props.name: notice
props.description: A status row between the header and the content.

props.name: width
props.description: Content width, forwarded to the existing `Container`; default `content`. Fixed for the mount: the width is chosen when the page mounts, so pass a new key or remount to switch widths.

name: page-frame
description: A frame with fixed chrome and a body that takes the remaining space; the parent owns the chrome.

props.name: notice
props.description: A full-width status or alert row between the header and the body.

props.name: footer
props.description: A persistent region after the body, typically a composer or action bar.

name: page-header
description: The title block at the top of a full page: a name, one line of purpose, page-level actions.

props.name: leading
props.description: A mark before the title, such as an icon. Presence is fixed for the mount: omitting it, or passing `null` or `false`, keeps the title as a direct child of the copy block.

props.name: actions
props.description: Switches and buttons that act on the whole page.

name: pagination
description: Moves through pages of a host-owned record set, with a known or unknown total.

props.name: page
props.description: The current 1-based page. The host owns it: a click only calls onPageChange.

props.name: pageCount
props.description: Total pages when the host knows it; numbered pages are shown. Omit it for an unknown total: Previous/Next and the page fact remain, and hasNext decides whether Next acts.

props.name: hasNext
props.description: Whether a later page exists when pageCount is omitted. Ignored when pageCount is given.

props.name: busy
props.description: The host is loading a page: controls keep focus and place but do not act.

props.name: siblings
props.description: Pages kept on each side of the current one. Fixed for the mount.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark.

props.name: pageLabel
props.description: Accessible name of a numbered page.

props.name: pageStatus
props.description: The page fact: shown for an unknown total, and in place of the numbered pages when the bar is too narrow for them. pageCount is undefined when the total is unknown.

name: path-label
description: A file path that keeps the file name visible when space runs out. Text only: never resolves a path, grants access or opens a file.

name: path-picker
description: Controlled path editing with an optional host-owned chooser.

props.name: onChoose
props.description: Selection only supplies a path. Access and persistence belong to the host.

name: pill
description: A toggle or filter chip when supplied an action; the caller owns its active state.

name: popover
description: A floating panel anchored to a trigger, in the top layer.

props.name: id
props.description: Base id for the ARIA references this component wires; generated when omitted.

props.name: anchorElement
props.description: Element whose layout defines a custom rect; observed by the same autoUpdate.

props.name: onKeyDown
props.description: Prevent default on Escape to leave an inner pane before dismissing the layer.

name: process-group
description: Collapsible record of what the assistant did; native details owns expansion and keyboard.

props.name: title
props.description: The group's name and size, for example "Process · 3 steps".

props.name: status
props.description: The group's state right after the name: pass the shared state badge, for example `<Status state="success" label="Completed" />`. Plain words still render as a quiet fact.

props.name: trailing
props.description: One quiet right-aligned fact, such as the total duration or "2 / 4". Not a row of dots.

name: process-step
description: One row of a ProcessGroup: icon, a single truncated line, a quiet fact.

props.name: meta
props.description: Duration, count or other quiet fact at the row's end.

name: progress
description: Native progress: a known amount, or an indeterminate bar when value is omitted.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Spinner remains the wait with no known amount.

props.name: value
props.description: Omit for an indeterminate bar. Finite values are handed to the native progress element.

name: prose
description: Long-form reading content. Native headings, paragraphs, lists, quotes, code, rules and tables inside it take the same reading rhythm as chat markdown; arranging controls and cards stays with Stack, Inline and Grid.

name: rail-item
description: One destination in an IconRail: an icon alone when collapsed, icon and label when expanded.

props.name: current
props.description: The current location. Sets aria-current; the accent mark and fill follow it.

props.name: dot
props.description: Quiet marker on the icon, visible while the rail is collapsed. It is the `data-dot` attribute on the item, so a host can set or clear it at runtime without re-rendering.

props.name: meta
props.description: Text or count at the end, visible while the rail is expanded: a count, "In progress".

props.name: metaTone
props.description: "accent" marks activity happening now, such as "In progress"; otherwise the meta is a quiet fact.

props.name: href
props.description: A route renders an anchor; an action renders a button.

name: rail-section
description: A group of related destinations that folds into one shortcut icon when the rail is collapsed. The shortcut shows the current location and the attention dot of whichever child has them.

props.name: label
props.description: Eyebrow shown while the rail is expanded, for example "Expanded".

props.name: icon
props.description: While collapsed, the whole section is this one icon, pointing at `href`.

name: read-block
description: Displays a supplied file window; never opens the named path.

props.name: lang
props.description: Grammar hint for the entire supplied window; unknown grammars retain plain text.

name: resource-card
description: One prepared capability on an overview page: what it is, whether it runs, what to do next. The title sits one heading level below the surrounding `Page` or `Section`.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: What kind of thing it is, for example "Channel · Message card".

props.name: status
props.description: The state in words with its dot.

props.name: identity
props.description: The checkable technical identity, shown in monospace and low weight.

props.name: tone
props.description: "muted" is something present but not running: a dashed outline and quieter text.

name: resource-link
description: An actionable reference to an openable file, record, or artifact.

props.name: detail
props.description: Where it lives and which version, for example "docs/records · Revision 1".

props.name: trailing
props.description: Replaces the arrow, for a state the reader should see before opening.

props.name: href
props.description: A destination renders an anchor; an in-page action renders a button.

name: risk-confirmation
description: One host-requested acknowledgement; it never decides which actions need confirmation.

props.name: id
props.description: Base id for the ARIA references this component wires; generated when omitted.

name: search-block
description: Search matches grouped by file, with line numbers.
extends: ( | { kind: "paths"; paths: readonly string[] } | { kind: "matches"; files: readonly SearchFileGroup[] } )

name: search-input
description: A text input for search, with a search icon. Native search editing and form semantics; filtering belongs to the consumer.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name; placeholder text is only a hint.

name: section
description: One titled region inside a page or a card surface. Slots are fixed for the mount: presence decides whether the header or footer renders, while a Signal passed as slot content still updates the text it carries.

props.name: title
props.description: The section heading, rendered at the level the surrounding region grants it: h2 under `Page`, h3 where a section is nested in another section. Omitted only when the section is a pure grouping wrapper; a grouping wrapper does not consume a heading level, so its titled children keep the depth of the surrounding region.

props.name: description
props.description: One line of supporting copy under the heading.

props.name: actions
props.description: Section-level actions on the heading row; they wrap under it when it is narrow.

props.name: footer
props.description: A supporting note or action row after the content.

props.name: variant
props.description: `plain` keeps the page rhythm; `card` wraps the plain section in the existing Card surface. Fixed for the mount: the surface is chosen when the section mounts, so pass a new key or remount to switch variants.

name: segmented-control
description: A single choice, using native radio keyboard semantics; tabs remain a separate component.

props.name: id
props.description: Base id for the ARIA references this component wires; generated when omitted.

name: select
description: A native select menu, themed.

name: separator
description: A thin rule that divides groups of content or tools.

name: shortcut-keys
description: A keyboard shortcut, shown as keys. Effective key labels belong to the command owner, including platform differences.

name: skeleton
description: Decorative placeholder; the caller owns loading text and aria-busy on the content region.

name: skeleton-boundary
description: Shows skeletons in place of a region while it loads. Loading presentation preserves the mounted subtree; the caller owns request state.

name: slider
description: Native range control. The visible figure is the same value assistive technology reads.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the native range control.

name: spinner
description: An indeterminate loading indicator with a label that says what is loading.

name: stack
description: Lays out children in a column, with a gap from the spacing scale.

name: stat
description: One summary figure: a short label, the figure, and an optional supporting fact. The figure is the largest text in the block and is never colored; a state belongs in a Status beside it. Hosts place several Stats in a Grid, a Card, or a toolbar strip.

props.name: label
props.description: What the figure counts, in sentence case: "Active runs".

props.name: value
props.description: The figure itself. Pass "unknown" (or the host's word for it) when the value cannot be read.

props.name: detail
props.description: One supporting fact under the figure, such as its scope or when it was read.

props.name: href
props.description: Makes the whole summary a link to the records it counts; routing stays with the host.

name: state-dot
description: Marks execution-step progress, including an ongoing spinner and an optional done checkmark. It is decorative; the owner supplies adjacent accessible status text.

name: status
description: The state badge: a decorative dot and the state in a word or two, on a soft tint of the state's ink. Use as slot content; composed markers remain owned by WorkCard and Timeline.

props.name: label
props.description: Supply visible, non-empty content, including when the Child is dynamic.

name: status-dot
description: A work or connection status marker, optionally with a halo. It is decorative; the owner supplies adjacent accessible status text.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter in px; the state shape is drawn inside it.

props.name: halo
props.description: A soft ring behind the dot, for the one status that leads a surface (header, connection).

name: switch
description: A native checkbox with switch semantics; form reset and keyboard remain native.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Native indeterminate property. Assistive technology reads `aria-checked="mixed"`.

props.name: labelHidden
props.description: Keep the accessible name while hiding the visible label, for compact tables.

name: table
description: Data table. Sorting and selection are reported; row order and records stay with the caller.

name: tabs
description: Items are fixed for the mount, and panels stay mounted to preserve drafts.

props.name: id
props.description: Base id for the ARIA references this component wires; generated when omitted.

name: tag
description: A categorical or metadata label; use Pill for interactive filters.

name: task-list
description: An ordered plan of host-reported steps that an agent works through. It is not executable and not a ChatTask record: the host owns every state, and the list only shows them. Markers, strikethrough and the shimmer are visual; each row also carries its state as text for assistive technology.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Expanded on mount; native details owns expansion afterwards.

name: terminal-block
description: A command and its output, with the exit status.

name: text
description: One run of copy in a theme text role. Emphasis and fine print keep their native elements (`strong`, `em`, `small`) inside it.

props.name: as
props.description: A paragraph by default; `span` for a run inside a line, `div` for a block that holds other blocks.

name: text-shimmer
description: Text with a light sweep across it, for work in progress. Nested fragments share the outer sweep; the inert copy is excluded from accessibility.

props.name: children
props.description: Presentational fragments only: decoration duplicates them, so omit effects and element IDs.

name: textarea
description: A multi-line text input.

name: timeline
description: An ordered run of events that share one vertical line, newest or most active first.

name: timeline-item
description: One event on a Timeline: a marker, a title, its state and optional details.

props.name: state
props.description: What the marker says; `stateLabel` stays the source of truth.

props.name: actions
props.description: Controls that belong to this event, for example opening its log.

name: toast
description: A short notice that appears over the page. Host owns visibility, lifetime and placement; mounting does not schedule timers.

name: token-field
description: Several values entered as text: tokens the host resolves, removable while the reader types.

props.name: id
props.description: Id of the draft input; also the base for the token ids. Generated when omitted.

props.name: tokens
props.description: The host owns the tokens; a Signal keeps them live.

props.name: onAdd
props.description: Called with trimmed, non-empty draft text on Enter, a separator or a paste. The host resolves, deduplicates or rejects it and updates `tokens`. Return false to keep the draft for correction.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Called when the reader removes a token; the host decides.

props.name: separators
props.description: Characters that end a token as they are typed or pasted.

props.name: listLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the token list.

props.name: invalidMessage
props.description: Read after a token's name when the host marked it invalid.

props.name: name
props.description: Submits one value per token under this name.

props.name: required
props.description: At least one token; enforced through the draft's custom validity.

name: toolbar
description: A group of related controls that shares one Tab stop; the arrow keys move between them.

props.name: label
props.description: Every toolbar needs an accessible name, even when its controls are icon-only.

name: tooltip
description: Non-interactive help. Popover owns positioning, top-layer dismissal and cleanup.

props.name: id
props.description: Base id for the ARIA references this component wires; generated when omitted.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Use a focusable control with its own accessible name; this is supplementary text.

name: tree-view
description: A hierarchy to explore and select from, with the tree keyboard model.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the tree.

props.name: items
props.description: The host owns the hierarchy; a Signal keeps it live and rows keep their DOM by id.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Controlled open branches. Omit it to keep them locally from defaultExpanded.

props.name: selected
props.description: Controlled selection. Omit it to keep it locally from defaultSelected.

name: web-block
description: A web search result: an answer and the pages it came from.
extends: ( | { kind: "search"; answer?: Child; sources: readonly WebSourceView[]; truncated?: boolean } | { kind: "fetch"; url: string; statusCode: number; truncated?: boolean } )

name: window-title-bar
description: The title bar of a window whose native title bar is hidden but whose window controls remain (a desktop shell). The shell reports the room it needs as `--mygo-titlebar-height`, `--mygo-titlebar-inset-left` (traffic lights) and `--mygo-titlebar-inset-right`; the bar keeps clear of that room and marks itself as the window's drag area with `--app-region: drag`, while buttons, links and fields inside it opt out. Double-click zooming is the shell's job. The component does not detect the platform: the host renders it only where the shell exists, and in a browser tab the variables fall back to a plain bar.

props.name: title
props.description: Window or page name, centred between the slots. Part of the drag area.

props.name: leading
props.description: After the native window controls, for example navigation. Interactive children stay clickable.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Window-level actions at the far edge. Interactive children stay clickable.

name: work-card
description: A work reference inside a conversation: one control that opens the work's details.

props.name: state
props.description: What the dot says; the words in `status` stay the source of truth.

props.name: status
props.description: Current status in words, for example "In progress: reviewing the record format".

props.name: detail
props.description: A quiet extra fact after the status, for example "1 outcome linked".

props.name: action
props.description: Label of the open affordance; the whole card is the control.
